checks.name: Corrected application readiness targets: 216 JavaScript and 98 Python passing; three local Postgres skips. Nine focused plan-refresh tests passed. Initial loopback sandbox failure and resumed targets are retained in the evidence.

findings.disposition: One approved participant can consume shared rolling provider limits. Existing minute limits and isolated staging contain exposure. Durable per-actor quotas are required before cohort expansion.

Private join capability remains in a URL and can be copied from browser history or sharing. Approved authentication, hashed storage, rotation and telemetry redaction reduce exposure. Exchange design or explicit production risk decision is deferred.

limitations: Targeted primary-agent delta review plus hash-verified reuse of eleven unchanged control files from the owner-accepted 6b9719b report. Not a fresh whole-repository review, independent audit or Security Scan.
The runtime delta is one mobile plan screen. No new unresolved critical or high runtime finding was identified in that delta; findings outside the reviewed controls may remain undiscovered.

Component tests reproduce overlapping callbacks and ambiguous previous-vote feedback. They do not establish the native gesture frequency, the cause of every historical Android request, or device acceptance for 2ad48a8. No corrected native artifact exists yet.

Provider advisories, hosted configuration and database grants were not freshly audited. Three Postgres-specific checks are skipped locally. Existing 6b9719b source-review acceptance and partial native evidence do not transfer to this source.

One API process remains required for replay and provider coordination. Shared quotas and private capability URLs remain open medium risks for isolated staging only. Production, retention, Auth deletion, scaling, stores and cohort expansion remain separate decisions.
